description: A young woman with curly dark hair and gold hoop earrings, in a lilac knitted top and a cream skirt, takes a mirror selfie with her phone. A grey parrot with a red tail stands on her shoulder and keeps flapping its wings next to her face. She frowns, squints and pushes her hand towards it, then lowers the phone, rubs her forehead and looks annoyed. The room has mint-green walls, blue wooden shutters, a cane chair with clothes, a bird perch and an amber chandelier.
